RTS.gcticks: RTS-reported CPU ticks spent on GC
RTS.mutticks: RTS-reported CPU ticks spent on mutator
Stat.cputicks: Kernel-reported CPU ticks (1/100th of a second), since process start
blockNum: Number of blocks in this chain fragment.
blockfetchclient.blockdelay: delay (s) of the latest block fetch
blockfetchclient.blockdelay.cdfFive: probability for block fetch to complete within 5s
blockfetchclient.blockdelay.cdfOne: probability for block fetch to complete within 1s
blockfetchclient.blockdelay.cdfThree: probability for block fetch to complete within 3s
blockfetchclient.blocksize: block size (bytes) of the latest block fetch
blockfetchclient.lateblocks: number of block fetches that took longer than 5s
blocksForged: How many blocks did this node forge?
density: The actual number of blocks created over the maximum expected number of blocks that could be created over the span of the last @k@ blocks.
epoch: In which epoch is the tip of the current chain.
forgedSlotLast: Slot number of the last forged block
forging_enabled: A node without forger credentials or started as non-producing has forging disabled.
GSM.state: The state of the Genesis State Machine. 0 = PreSyncing, 1 = Syncing, 2 = CaughtUp.
node.start.time: The UTC time this node was started represented in POSIX seconds.
nodeCannotForge: How many times was this node unable to forge [a block]?
nodeIsLeader: How many times was this node slot leader?
peerSelection.ActiveBigLedgerPeers: Number of active big ledger peers
peerSelection.ActiveBigLedgerPeersDemoti: Number of active big ledger peers demotions
peerSelection.ActiveBootstrapPeersDemoti: Number of active bootstrap peers demotions
peerSelection.ActiveLocalRootPeers: Number of active local root peers
peerSelection.ActiveLocalRootPeersDemoti: Number of active local root peers demotions
peerSelection.ActiveNonRootPeers: Number of active non root peers
peerSelection.ActiveNonRootPeersDemotion: Number of active non root peers demotions
peerSelection.ColdBigLedgerPeers: Number of cold big ledger peers
peerSelection.ColdBigLedgerPeersPromotio: Number of cold big ledger peers promotions
peerSelection.ColdBootstrapPeersPromotio: Number of cold bootstrap peers promotions
peerSelection.ColdNonRootPeersPromotions: Number of cold non root peers promotions
peerSelection.EstablishedBigLedgerPeers: Number of established big ledger peers
peerSelection.EstablishedLocalRootPeers: Number of established local root peers
peerSelection.EstablishedNonRootPeers: Number of established non root peers
peerSelection.HotBigLedgerPeers: Number of hot big ledger peers
peerSelection.KnownBigLedgerPeers: Number of known big ledger peers
peerSelection.KnownLocalRootPeers: Number of known local root peers
peerSelection.KnownNonRootPeers: Number of known non root peers
peerSelection.LocalRoots: Numbers of warm & hot local roots
peerSelection.WarmBigLedgerPeers: Number of warm big ledger peers
peerSelection.WarmBigLedgerPeersDemotion: Number of warm big ledger peers demotions
peerSelection.WarmBigLedgerPeersPromotio: Number of warm big ledger peers promotions
peerSelection.WarmBootstrapPeersDemotion: Number of warm bootstrap peers demotions
peerSelection.WarmBootstrapPeersPromotio: Number of warm bootstrap peers promotions
peerSelection.WarmLocalRootPeersPromotio: Number of warm local root peers promotions
peerSelection.WarmNonRootPeersDemotions: Number of warm non root peers demotions
peerSelection.WarmNonRootPeersPromotions: Number of warm non root peers promotions
peerSelection.churn.DecreasedActiveBigLe: number of decreased active big ledger peers
peerSelection.churn.DecreasedEstablished: number of decreased established big ledger peers
peerSelection.churn.DecreasedKnownBigLed: number of decreased known big ledger peers
peerSelection.churn.IncreasedActiveBigLe: number of increased active big ledger peers
peerSelection.churn.IncreasedEstablished: number of increased established big ledger peers
peerSelection.churn.IncreasedKnownBigLed: number of increased known big ledger peers
peerSelection.churn.hot.demotedTopScore: Highest demotion score among the hot peers demoted to warm at the last churn; the score a peer had to beat to stay hot
peerSelection.churn.hot.retainedBottomSc: Lowest demotion score among the hot peers which stayed hot at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.hot.retainedMedianSc: Median demotion score among the hot peers which stayed hot at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.hot.retainedTopScore: Highest demotion score among the hot peers which stayed hot at the last churn; the incumbent an attacker would have to out-score
peerSelection.churn.hot.eligiblePeers: Number of hot peers which were available to demote at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.hot.retainedGiniPerm: Gini coefficient, in per-mille, of the demotion scores of the hot peers which stayed hot at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.hot.topDSharePermill: Share, in per-mille, of all demotion scores held by as many of the strongest hot peers as were demoted at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.hot.zeroScorers: Number of hot peers without any demotion score at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.hot.scoreSum: Sum of the demotion scores of all hot peers at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.demotedTop: Highest demotion score among the hot big ledger peers demoted to warm at the last churn; the score a peer had to beat to stay hot
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.retainedBo: Lowest demotion score among the hot big ledger peers which stayed hot at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.retainedMe: Median demotion score among the hot big ledger peers which stayed hot at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.retainedTo: Highest demotion score among the hot big ledger peers which stayed hot at the last churn; the incumbent an attacker would have to out-score
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.eligiblePe: Number of hot big ledger peers which were available to demote at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.retainedGi: Gini coefficient, in per-mille, of the demotion scores of the hot big ledger peers which stayed hot at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.topDShareP: Share, in per-mille, of all demotion scores held by as many of the strongest hot big ledger peers as were demoted at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.zeroScorer: Number of hot big ledger peers without any demotion score at the last churn
peerSelection.churn.bigLedger.scoreSum: Sum of the demotion scores of all hot big ledger peers at the last churn
served.block: This counter metric indicates how many blocks this node has served.
served.block.latest: This counter metric indicates how many chain tip blocks this node has served.
served.header: A counter triggered only on header event with falling edge
slotInEpoch: Relative slot number of the tip of the current chain within the epoch..
slotNum: Number of slots in this chain fragment.
slotsMissed: How many slots did this node miss?
systemStartTime: The UTC time this node was started.
tipBlock: Values for hash, parent hash and issuer verification key hash
txsSyncDuration: Latest time to sync the mempool in ms after block adoption
txsSyncDurationTotal: Cumulative time spent syncing the mempool in ms after block adoption
egress.writeTimeouts: Node-to-node muxes dropped because the peer took nothing within the SDU timeout
egress.writeTimeouts.gate: Of those, the ones that timed out at the writability gate of scheduled egress
localEgress.writeTimeouts: Node-to-client muxes dropped because the peer took nothing within the SDU timeout
localEgress.writeTimeouts.gate: Of those, the ones that timed out at the writability gate of scheduled egress
ingress.readTimeouts: Node-to-node muxes dropped because an SDU did not arrive in full within the SDU timeout
ingress.overruns: Node-to-node muxes dropped because the peer exceeded a mini-protocol's ingress limit
ingress.protocolErrors: Node-to-node muxes dropped for undecodable SDUs, unknown mini-protocols, or data an initiator-only mux cannot take
ingress.bearerClosed: Node-to-node muxes that ended because the peer closed the connection
localIngress.readTimeouts: Node-to-client muxes dropped because an SDU did not arrive in full within the SDU timeout
localIngress.overruns: Node-to-client muxes dropped because the peer exceeded a mini-protocol's ingress limit
localIngress.protocolErrors: Node-to-client muxes dropped for undecodable SDUs, unknown mini-protocols, or data an initiator-only mux cannot take
localIngress.bearerClosed: Node-to-client muxes that ended because the peer closed the connection
egress.direct.bytes: Bytes of the node's own requests, charged to the egress budget on credit
egress.slice.bytes: Bytes the egress slice sent from its own share
egress.slice.borrowedBytes: Bytes the egress slice sent on the budget's idle capacity
egress.scheduled.bytes: Bytes served through the ranked egress queue
egress.scheduled.batches: Batches served through the ranked egress queue
egress.scheduled.waitTokens: Seconds egress batches waited for tokens, summed
egress.scheduled.waitWritable: Seconds egress batches waited for the socket to accept them, summed
egress.scheduled.waitsOver.1ms: Egress batches whose token wait exceeded 1ms
egress.scheduled.waitsOver.10ms: Egress batches whose token wait exceeded 10ms
egress.scheduled.waitsOver.100ms: Egress batches whose token wait exceeded 100ms
egress.scheduled.waitsOver.1s: Egress batches whose token wait exceeded 1s
egress.scheduled.waitsOver.10s: Egress batches whose token wait exceeded 10s
egress.budget.level: Token level of the egress budget in bytes; negative while repaying credit
egress.budget.queued: Bearers waiting on the egress budget
egress.slice.queued: Bearers waiting on the egress slice
egress.budget.bursts: Busy periods of the egress budget: from a first bearer queued to none
egress.budget.busyTime: Seconds with a bearer queued on the egress budget, the budget binding
egress.budget.contendedTime: Seconds with two or more bearers queued on the egress budget, strict priority deciding
egress.budget.burstsWider.2: Egress busy periods with at least 2 bearers queued at once
egress.budget.burstsWider.8: Egress busy periods with at least 8 bearers queued at once
egress.budget.burstsWider.32: Egress busy periods with at least 32 bearers queued at once
egress.tier.localRoot.bytes: Bytes the egress queue granted local roots; the fast path is not ranked and counts nowhere
egress.tier.localRoot.batches: Batches the egress queue granted local roots
egress.tier.localRoot.queued: Bearers of local roots waiting on the egress budget
egress.tier.partner.bytes: Bytes the egress queue granted partners; the fast path is not ranked and counts nowhere
egress.tier.partner.batches: Batches the egress queue granted partners
egress.tier.partner.queued: Bearers of partners waiting on the egress budget
egress.tier.residual.bytes: Bytes the egress queue granted the rest of the peers; the fast path is not ranked and counts nowhere
egress.tier.residual.batches: Batches the egress queue granted the rest of the peers
egress.tier.residual.queued: Bearers of the rest of the peers waiting on the egress budget
egress.tier.unranked.bytes: Bytes the egress queue granted unranked bearers; the fast path is not ranked and counts nowhere
egress.tier.unranked.batches: Batches the egress queue granted unranked bearers
egress.tier.unranked.queued: Bearers of unranked bearers waiting on the egress budget
